title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage (Regulatory Levies) Amendment Bill 2018
short_title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage (Regulatory Levies) Amendment Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would extend well investigation, annual well and well activity levies to greenhouse gas wells, and update existing offshore petroleum levy arrangements.
It would recover regulatory costs as greenhouse gas well oversight moved to the National Offshore Petroleum Safety and Environmental Management Authority (NOPSEMA) under companion legislation.
The new greenhouse gas levies would begin alongside the companion bill's transfer of oversight, with corresponding state and territory levies subject to specified regulatory arrangements.
changes: A well activity levy would apply when five-yearly revisions of well operations management plans were submitted.
The levy on applications for approval to commence Commonwealth well activities would be removed.
Safety and well investigation levy provisions would be updated to refer to compliance investigations under the regulatory powers legislation.
For annual levy purposes, covered well abandonment would require the relevant notification from NOPSEMA confirming compliance with the management plan.
summary.affected: Offshore petroleum and greenhouse gas titleholders subject to the levy provisions would be affected.
